reuse.why: Extends the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked and linkBankSyncAccount, but writes unlinkReplacedAccounts with the same field reset as unlinkAccount instead of extracting a local-unlink helper from it.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount reset of account_id/bank/balances/sync_source/sync_status is a verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's block; the flag plumbing is repeated across six provider handlers, following the existing pattern.

placement.why: The logic stays in accounts/app.ts next to the shared link pipeline, though the field reset belongs with unlinkAccount and the 'assert' helper now also returns data to act on.

scope.why: Only the flag, its plumbing, the local unlink, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Two copies of what 'unlinked' means can drift, assertBankAccountNotLinked gains a boolean that changes it from a guard into a query, and the unlink call is repeated in both branches of linkBankSyncAccount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: unlinkReplacedAccounts in server/accounts/app.ts re-implements the local part of unlinkAccount instead of sharing it

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated field reset is a near-verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's update, not a reshaped one
